notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is out!
notes.notes:
Hey all, we've just released a small update adding support to additional languages and with some minor bug fixes!

[list]
[*] The game is now localized in [b]Spanish, French, Traditional Chinese, German, and Japanese![/b],
[*] Added d-pad support to select a character before the run.,
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed QuickLeaf Boots issue where if both characters had the boots, whenever one of the character upgraded their boots the other one would lose their buff.
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed language not being saved after changing it in the options menu.
[/list]

As always thanks for all the positive feedback so far!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
This patch brings some small changes we were able to address right away!

The main change is the removal of character swapping in single-player mode. After seeing how it impacted gameplay, we decided it wasn’t improving the experience as intended. Let us know if you have any thoughts on this change!

[b]Changes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Removed the ability to swap character controls in single-player mode.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues that could prevent completing the [i]Juice Extravaganza[/i] and [i]Pest Control[/i] achievements.
[*] Corrected small text errors in some cards.
[/list]

notes.title: - New Update - Steam Remote Play Together
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We are part of the Remote Play Together Fest! And because of that, we decided to release a new update to our demo! 

This update includes:

[list]
[*] New Sauce: Shocking Mustard - When hitting enemies you have the chance to create electric attacks that jump to nearby enemies and deal damage to them.

[*] New Item: Smackback Helmet - When you take damage, you deal damage to neaby enemies too.

[*] New Item: Veggie Puff Pump - Makes all your attacks bigger!

[*] Reroll Feature: Now you can refresh your upgrade options during level up! You can reroll up to 3 times per run to find that card you are looking for.

[*] New Elite Enemies behaviors and art.

[*] Balancing adjustments.
[/list]

Go call a friend and play together locally or online (with remote play)!
